name: Palladous-Dolina
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are massive canyon systems, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Trade at the automated beacon of unknown purpose changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
